question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Absurd
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Absurd"** means something that is wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate. (बेतुका)

 
 
• **Example: **The idea that the earth is flat is **absurd.**
 
 
 
• **"Irrational" **refers to something that is not logical or reasonable. (अतार्किक)
 
 
• **Example: **His fear of flying is **irrational, **given how safe modern aviation is.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Absurd' **is **'Irrational'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abstruse **(जटिल): Difficult to understand; obscure.

 
 
• **Example:** The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics was** abstruse.**
 
 
 
• **Sudden **(अचानक): Occurring or done quickly and unexpectedly or without warning.
 
 
• **Example: **There was a **sudden **change in the weather.
 
 
 
• **Arbitrary** (मनमाना): Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.
 
 
• **Example:** The decision to cancel the event seemed **arbitrary** and unfair.
